description_en: Verifies the enterprise name, enterprise certificate number, and legal representative name. The verification passes only when all three elements match and the enterprise is in active operation
description_zh: 用于核验企业名称、企业证件号和企业法人姓名，必须全部一致且企业经营状态为在营才会判定核验通过
kebab_example: aliyun dytnsapi company-three-elements-verification --ep-cert-no '9242032*******J627' --ep-cert-name '某企业' --legal-person-cert-name '张三' --auth-code 'Dd1r***4id' --api-version 2020-02-17 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CompanyThreeElementsVerification

parameters.help_en:
The name of the legal representative of the enterprise.
If the enterprise has multiple legal representatives, separate their names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
企业法人姓名。
如果企业有多个法人，法人之间需用中文顿号（”、”）隔开
parameters.name: legal_person_cert_name

parameters.help_en:
The authorization code.

Log on to the Phone Number Dictionary console (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC). On the My Applications (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply) page, obtain the authorization ID, which is the authorization code
parameters.help_zh:
授权码。

登录号码百科控制台 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/overview?spm=a2c4g.608385.0.0.79847f8b3awqUC)，在我的申请 (https://dytns.console.aliyun.com/analysis/apply)页面，获取授权ID即授权码
parameters.name: auth_code

AccessDeniedDetail.description_en: The details about the access denial

DetailInfo.description_en: The detailed information about the enterprise

EnterpriseStatus.description_en: The business status of the enterprise

OpenTime.description_en: The business operation period of the enterprise

items.description_en:
EpCertName: the enterprise name
EpCertNo: the enterprise certificate number
CertName: the name of the legal representative
items.description_zh:
EpCertName：企业名称
EpCertNo：企业证件号
CertName：企业法人姓名

ReasonCode.description_en:
The verification result code. Valid values:

0: The verification is consistent.
1: The verification is consistent, but the enterprise is not in normal operation.
2: The person-enterprise verification is inconsistent.
3: The enterprise two-element verification fails.
4: The enterprise is not found.
5: The person does not exist in the database
ReasonCode.description_zh:
核验结果编码。取值：

0：核验一致
1：核验一致，企业非正常营业
2：人企核验不一致
3：企业二要素不通过
4：查无企业
5：人在库中不存在

VerifyResult.description_en:
The verification result. Valid values:

true: The information is verified to be consistent, and the enterprise is in normal operation.
false: The verification fails
VerifyResult.description_zh:
核验结果。取值：

true：信息核验一致，且企业正常经营。
false：核验不通过

Message.description_en: The description of the returned status code

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This is a common parameter. The ID returned for each request is unique and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求返回的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题
